$comment: VIPM CLI exit codes (https://docs.vipm.io/2026-Q3/cli/command-reference/#exit-codes) with the remediation hints that Run-Pipeline.ps1 and the Linux/Windows container pipelines print when a vipm command fails.

1.name: GENERAL_ERROR
1.hint: Read the 'error:' lines above; set VIPM_DEBUG=1 for a detailed trace.

2.name: COMMAND_SYNTAX_ERROR
2.hint: Invalid arguments or manifest. Also returned when no package version satisfies a vipm.toml constraint or vipm.lock is out of sync with vipm.toml (run `vipm lock`). If `vipm lock` cannot resolve packages that are installed (private packages from the .vipc), declare `labview-bitness` in vipm.toml itself: lock resolves installed packages for the manifest's bitness only (32-bit when absent) and ignores --labview-bitness and .vipm/config.toml.

3.name: PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND
3.hint: No configured repository serves the package. Run `vipm refresh`, check the name at vipm.io, or ship private packages through the project's vipcPath.

4.name: LABVIEW_VERSION_NOT_FOUND
4.hint: The selected LabVIEW is not installed or not registered with VIPM. Set the project's labviewVersion/labviewBitness (written to .vipm/config.toml) to an installed version; `vipm labview list` shows what VIPM detects.

5.name: NETWORK_REPOSITORY_ERROR
5.hint: A package repository or NIPM feed is unreachable. Check network access and http_proxy/https_proxy, then retry (`vipm refresh`).

6.name: ENTITLEMENT_ERROR
6.hint: The command needs VIPM Pro. Check the activation with `vipm about` and re-run `vipm activate`.

7.name: DEPENDENCY_CONFLICT
7.hint: Package requirements conflict. Review the version constraints in vipm.toml and the packages' dependencies.

8.name: IO_ERROR
8.hint: File access or VIPM Desktop communication failed. 'made no progress for Ns' means VIPM Desktop stalled (raise VIPM_DESKTOP_LIVELINESS_TIMEOUT or check that VIPM Desktop can reach LabVIEW).

9.name: PACKAGE_ALREADY_INSTALLED
9.hint: The package is already installed; pass --upgrade to replace it.

10.name: AUTHENTICATION_FAILURE
10.hint: vipm.io or feed authentication failed. Re-run `vipm activate` or `vipm login`.

11.name: BUILD_FAILED
11.hint: The build ran but failed; no artifact was produced. Read the LabVIEW/VIPM errors above.

12.name: BUILD_TARGET_NOT_FOUND
12.hint: The build target or build specification does not exist in vipm.toml or the .lvproj.

13.name: INVALID_FILE_TYPE
13.hint: The input file type is not supported by this command (.vip, .ogp, .vipc, .dragon, vipm.toml, .lvproj, .vipb).

14.name: FILE_PARSE_ERROR
14.hint: vipm.toml, vipm.lock, .vipm/config.toml or the package file could not be parsed.

15.name: FILE_NOT_FOUND
15.hint: An input file does not exist; check the configured paths (vipcPath, manifests) against the checkout.

16.name: CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
16.hint: The command needs confirmation; pass -y or set VIPM_ASSUME_YES=1.

17.name: PACKAGE_DRIFT
17.hint: Installed packages differ from vipm.lock/vipm.toml (listed above). Install the missing versions (for example through vipcPath) or allow drift.

18.name: MISSING_REFERENCED_FILES
18.hint: Files referenced by the project are missing on disk (listed above); pass --allow-missing-files to proceed anyway.

19.name: COMPONENT_INCOMPATIBLE
19.hint: The selected LabVIEW is newer than this VIPM CLI supports; update the VIPM CLI or select an older LabVIEW.

20.name: LABVIEW_VERSION_TOO_OLD
20.hint: This command needs LabVIEW 2024 or newer; set the project's labviewVersion to a newer installed LabVIEW.

21.name: NOT_IMPLEMENTED
21.hint: The operation is not supported on this platform or edition.

22.name: ACTIVATION_FAILED
22.hint: VIPM Pro activation failed; check the serial number, name and email.

23.name: PROJECT_HAS_UNSAVED_CHANGES
23.hint: Save or close the LabVIEW project before running the command.

24.name: LABVIEW_VI_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE
24.hint: VIPM could not reach LabVIEW's VI Server. Enable server.tcp.enabled in LabVIEW.ini and check the port (`vipm labview list`).

25.name: CHECK_FAILED
25.hint: A verification check failed; see the details above.

124.name: TIMEOUT
124.hint: The operation timed out. Raise --timeout/VIPM_TIMEOUT, or VIPM_LABVIEW_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT when LabVIEW starts slowly.
